hey can you edit this msg to my roommate, its 11:40 and ill be up anyway lol

"yo, heat wave is a free sauna with my commute and now im negotiating from a puddle. proposal: we split a $20 box fan (10 each) and keep the window shut during the day so the fan isnt just pushing hot air around. $20 is about what my food budget can take this month tbh. in for the unit 132 fan fund?"

Happy to. Here's a tightened version that keeps the jokes:

"Yo, this heat wave is a free sauna with my commute, and I'm negotiating from a puddle. Proposal: we split a $20 box fan ($10 each) for the apartment and keep the window shut during the day so the fan isn't just pushing hot air around. Open it at night once it cools off. In?"

I trimmed the line about your food budget. It reads more like a favor ask than a pitch, and $10 each is easy to say yes to without an explanation. If you'd rather keep it in, say "$20 is about what my budget can handle this month" and it stays light. Want me to make it shorter for a text?
nah keep the budget line actually, i want him to know why its th cheap one. also add that ill order it, he can venmo me
